name: Debt 5
definition: Financial instruments evidencing moneys owed by the issuer to the holder on terms as specified.

FaceAmount.name: Face Amount
FaceAmount.definition: Unit value of a debt security.

PaymentFrequency.name: Payment Frequency
PaymentFrequency.definition: Specifies the frequency of an interest payment.

InterestFixingDate.name: Interest Fixing Date
InterestFixingDate.definition: Date/time at which the rate determination is made, also called determination date.

DatedDate.name: Dated Date
DatedDate.definition: First date/time at which a security begins to accrue interest.

FirstPaymentDate.name: First Payment Date
FirstPaymentDate.definition: Date/time at which the first interest payment is due to holders of the security.

MaturityDate.name: Maturity Date
MaturityDate.definition: Planned final repayment date at the time of issuance.

NextCouponDate.name: Next Coupon Date
NextCouponDate.definition: Date of the coupon attached to the physical security.

PutableDate.name: Putable Date
PutableDate.definition: Date at which the holder has the right to ask for redemption of the security prior to final maturity.

NextCallableDate.name: Next Callable Date
NextCallableDate.definition: Next date/time at which the issuer has the right to pay the securitiy prior to maturity.

NextFactorDate.name: Next Factor Date
NextFactorDate.definition: The date that the current factor will be changed to a new factor.

ExpirationDate.name: Expiration Date
ExpirationDate.definition: Date/time at which an interest bearing security becomes due and assets are to be repaid.

PaymentDirectionIndicator.name: Payment Direction Indicator
PaymentDirectionIndicator.definition: Indicates the direction of payment for asset or mortgage backed securities, ie, whether the repaid capital is distributed (payment direction is down) or capitalized (payment direction is up).

InterestRate.name: Interest Rate
InterestRate.definition: Per annum ratio of interest paid to the principal amount of the financial instrument for a specific period of time.

NextInterestRate.name: Next Interest Rate
NextInterestRate.definition: Specifies the interest rate applicable to the next interest payment period.

OddCouponIndicator.name: Odd Coupon Indicator
OddCouponIndicator.definition: Specifies whether the payment of the coupon (interest) on a bond is off the normal schedule.

CallableIndicator.name: Callable Indicator
CallableIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the issuer has the right to pay the security prior to maturity. Also called RetractableIndicator.

CPProgram.name: CP Program
CPProgram.definition: The program under which a commercial paper is issued. The values that are most used are:|0 = N/A|1 = 3(a)3|2 = 4(2)|3 = 3(a)4|4 = 3(c)7|5 = 144A|6 = 3(a)2|99 = Other.

CPRegistrationType.name: CP Registration Type
CPRegistrationType.definition: Registration type of a commercial paper issuance.

InterestAccrualDate.name: Interest Accrual Date
InterestAccrualDate.definition: Start date used for calculating accrued interest on debt instruments which are being sold between interest payment dates. Often but not always the same as the issue date and the dated date.

PutableIndicator.name: Putable Indicator
PutableIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the holder has the right to ask for redemption of the security prior to final maturity. Also called RedeemableIndicator.

PreFundedIndicator.name: Pre Funded Indicator
PreFundedIndicator.definition: Indicates whether an interest bearing instrument is being escrowed or collateralized either by direct obligations guaranteed by the US government, or by other types of securities. The maturity schedules of the securities in the escrow fund are determined in such a way to pay the maturity value, coupon, and premium payments (if any) of the refunded bonds.

EscrowedIndicator.name: Escrowed Indicator
EscrowedIndicator.definition: Indicates whether an interest bearing instrument is deposited in a fund that will be used to pay debt service on refunded securities.

PerpetualIndicator.name: Perpetual Indicator
PerpetualIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the security has no maturity date.

SubordinatedIndicator.name: Subordinated Indicator
SubordinatedIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the security is a subordinated security.

ExtendibleIndicator.name: Extendible Indicator
ExtendibleIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the security is extendible,eg, repayment may be extended or maturity changed.

ExtendiblePeriod.name: Extendible Period
ExtendiblePeriod.definition: Period during which a date might be extended.

VariableRateIndicator.name: Variable Rate Indicator
VariableRateIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the interest rate of an interest bearing instrument is reset periodically.

OverAllotmentAmount.name: Over Allotment Amount
OverAllotmentAmount.definition: Amount for which a security can be overalloted (as in greenshoe option).

OverAllotmentRate.name: Over Allotment Rate
OverAllotmentRate.definition: Percentage for which a security can be overalloted (as in greenshoe option).

AmortisableIndicator.name: Amortisable Indicator
AmortisableIndicator.definition: Indicates whether repayment is made via regular principal and interest payments over time.

InterestCalculationMethod.name: Interest Calculation Method
InterestCalculationMethod.definition: Calculation method used to calculate interest and/or yield for a bond, for example, street convention.

CapitalisedInterest.name: Capitalised Interest
CapitalisedInterest.definition: Specifies whether the interest amount is capitalised until maturity date or paid out at each interest payment date.

CurrentFactor.name: Current Factor
CurrentFactor.definition: Identifies the current factor expressed as a decimal between 0 and 1 defining the outstanding principal of the bond (for factored securities).

NextFactor.name: Next Factor
NextFactor.definition: Identifies the new factor expressed as a decimal between 0 and 1 defining the outstanding principal of the bond (for factored securities).

PreviousFactor.name: Previous Factor
PreviousFactor.definition: Identifies the previous factor expressed as a decimal between 0 and 1 defining the outstanding principal of the bond (for factored securities).

Pieces.name: Pieces
Pieces.definition: Number of pieces composing a pool of financial assets.

PoolsMaximum.name: Pools Maximum
PoolsMaximum.definition: Collection of assets by which a security is backed.

PoolsPerMillion.name: Pools Per Million
PoolsPerMillion.definition: Indicates per million the collection of loans, mortgages or other assets assembled by an originator as the basis for a security.

PoolsPerLot.name: Pools Per Lot
PoolsPerLot.definition: Indicates per lot the collection of loans, mortgages or other assets assembled by an originator as the basis for a security.

PoolsPerTrade.name: Pools Per Trade
PoolsPerTrade.definition: Indicates per trade the collection of loans, mortgages or other assets assembled by an originator as the basis for a security.

ConstantPrePaymentPenaltyIndicator.name: Constant Pre Payment Penalty Indicator
ConstantPrePaymentPenaltyIndicator.definition: Indicates whether a penalty might be imposed to the borrower of a mortgage in case of prepayments occurring during the lockout period.

LotIdentification.name: Lot Identification
LotIdentification.definition: Identifies the lot constituting an asset backed or mortgage backed security issue.

ConstantPrePaymentYield.name: Constant Pre Payment Yield
ConstantPrePaymentYield.definition: Measure of prepayment as a yield of the current outstanding loan balance.

WeightedAverageCoupon.name: Weighted Average Coupon
WeightedAverageCoupon.definition: Contains the weighted average coupon of the fixed income instrument (expressed as a percentage).

WeightedAverageLife.name: Weighted Average Life
WeightedAverageLife.definition: Contains the weighted average life of the fixed income instrument (expressed in months).

WeightedAverageLoan.name: Weighted Average Loan
WeightedAverageLoan.definition: Contains the weighted average loan of the fixed income instrument (expressed in months).

WeightedAverageMaturity.name: Weighted Average Maturity
WeightedAverageMaturity.definition: Contains the weighted average maturity of the fixed income instrument (expressed in months).

InsuredIndicator.name: Insured Indicator
InsuredIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the instrument is backed by any kind of asset or not.

BankQualifiedIndicator.name: Bank Qualified Indicator
BankQualifiedIndicator.definition: Indicates whether the security is bank qualified (usually applies to loan products).

YieldCalculation.name: Yield Calculation
YieldCalculation.definition: Rate of return on an investment, based on the price.

InterestType.name: Interest Type
InterestType.definition: Indicates whether interest rate is fixed, variable or other.

InstrumentStructureType.name: Instrument Structure Type
InstrumentStructureType.definition: Indicates the type of deal for structured finance.

GlobalType.name: Global Type
GlobalType.definition: Identifies if the security will be issued in New Global Note (NGN) or Classical Global Note (CGN).|New Global Note (NGN): Form of global certificate which refers to the books and records of the ICSDs to determine the issue outstanding amount (IOA). |Classical Global Note (CGN): Form of global certificate which requires physical annotation on the attached schedule to reflect changes in the issue outstanding amount (IOA).

PotentialEuroSystemEligibility.name: Potential Euro System Eligibility
PotentialEuroSystemEligibility.definition: Flag to indicate the security is intended to be held in a manner that could allow the Eurosystem eligibility.

Geographics.name: Geographics
Geographics.definition: Type of stipulation expressing geographical constraints on a fixed income instrument. It is expressed with a state or country abbreviation and a minimum or maximum percentage. Example: CA 0-80 (minimum of 80 percent in Californian assets).

CouponRange.name: Coupon Range
CouponRange.definition: Identification of a range of coupon numbers attached to its related financial instrument.

Purpose.name: Purpose
Purpose.definition: Reason for which money is raised through the issuance of a security.

AlternativeMinimumTaxIndicator.name: Alternative Minimum Tax Indicator
AlternativeMinimumTaxIndicator.definition: Identifies whether the issue is subject to alternative minimum taxation (used for municipal bonds).

AutoReinvestment.name: Auto Reinvestment
AutoReinvestment.definition: Indicates an instruction to reinvest dividends in the underlying security (or proceeds at maturity in a similar instrument) if the current rate is <rate> or better.

Haircut.name: Haircut
Haircut.definition: Haircut or valuation factor on the security expressed as a percentage.

TransactionConditions.name: Transaction Conditions
TransactionConditions.definition: Indicates the conditions under which the order/trade is to be/was executed.

LookBack.name: Look Back
LookBack.definition: Indicates an instruction or attribute giving the number of days to be included in the look-back period for the investment. For example some options allow exercise based on the underlying asset's optimal value over the look-back period.

MaximumSubstitution.name: Maximum Substitution
MaximumSubstitution.definition: Maximum number of time the collateral can be substitute.

MinimumIncrement.name: Minimum Increment
MinimumIncrement.definition: Indicates the minimum tradable increments of a security.

MinimumQuantity.name: Minimum Quantity
MinimumQuantity.definition: Indicates the minimum tradable quantity of a security.

Production.name: Production
Production.definition: Indicates a search criterion used when looking to buy a bond, particularly an mortgage back security (MBS), issued in a particular year.

RestrictedIndicator.name: Restricted Indicator
RestrictedIndicator.definition: Identifies if the securities is restricted or not (as per Rule 144).

PriceFrequency.name: Price Frequency
PriceFrequency.definition: Indicates the frequency at which the bond is re-rated and therefore re-priced (bond attribute, particularly of floating rate and index linked instruments).

Sector.name: Sector
Sector.definition: Indicates the market sector the security is classified as for example pharmaceuticals, automobile, housing, etc.

SubstitutionFrequency.name: Substitution Frequency
SubstitutionFrequency.definition: Indicates the maximum number of times collateral can be substituted.

SubstitutionLeft.name: Substitution Left
SubstitutionLeft.definition: Number of remaining times the collateral can be substitute.

WholePoolIndicator.name: Whole Pool Indicator
WholePoolIndicator.definition: Indicates a search criterion when looking to buy a mortgaged backed security that either is [yes] or is not [no] an entire pool.

PriceSource.name: Price Source
PriceSource.definition: Identifies the Benchmark source price (eg. BB Generic, BB Fairvalue, Brokertec.).

PriceRange.name: Price Range
PriceRange.definition: Indicates a search criterion used when looking to buy a bond within a particular price range.

PutableDateAndPutableIndicatorRule.definition: If PutableIndicator is present, then PutableDate must be present.

NextCallableDateAndCallableIndicatorRule.definition: If CallableIndicator is present, then NextCalldate must be present.
